idea-plugin.name: Chalkdraw
idea-plugin.description:
A chalkboard-inspired theme in four variants — Deep, Flat and Cool (dark) and Paper (light) — designed to minimize eye strain.

Built for the Islands UI: the editor and each tool window are cards on the window frame, using the two grounds each variant already carries.

Generated from the same palette as the VS Code theme, the Neovim colorscheme and the iTerm2 presets.
